title: Potato Egg Salad
description: Potato Egg Salad is a classic Continental salad made with tender baby potatoes, hard-boiled eggs, fresh herbs, and a creamy Dijon dressing. It is a refreshing and flavorful dish, perfect as a light meal, side dish, or appetizer.

ingredients.title: For the Salad Base
items: Baby potatoes (preferably Yukon Gold or new potatoes) – 500 g

ingredients.title: For the Dressing
items: Freshly ground black pepper – to taste

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Potatoes
steps: Boil in salted water until just tender (about 12–15 min depending on size).
Drain and cool slightly, then peel if desired.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Eggs
steps: Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for 9–10 minutes for hard-boiled perfection.
Cool in ice water, peel, and cut into quarters or cubes.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Make the Dressing
steps: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, white wine vinegar, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assemble the Salad
steps: In a large mixing bowl, combine potatoes, eggs, peas, onion, celery, and herbs.
Gently fold in the dressing until everything is lightly coated.
Avoid overmixing to keep the potatoes intact.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plate Professionally
steps: Use a ring mold to plate for a clean, restaurant-style presentation.
Garnish with microgreens, a light sprinkle of paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled as a light meal, appetizer, or side dish.
Pair with grilled chicken, roasted meats, or seafood.
Accompany with crusty bread or toasted baguette slices.

chefTips: Keep potatoes slightly firm; overcooked potatoes make the salad mushy.
Use Dijon mustard and a hint of vinegar to balance the richness of eggs and mayonnaise.
Serve on a chilled plate or platter, adding microgreens for a fresh, upscale look.
Add a few slices of smoked salmon or roasted bell peppers for a premium variation.
